描述想调整的地方，先看效果再应用: Describe your changes, then preview before applying

暖白相纸、双层细边与底部短线，像一张整理好的暗房印相。: Warm photo paper, double rules and quiet footer lines, inspired by darkroom prints.

根据照片的内容、构图与色彩自主设计，保持清晰的视觉层次与适当留白: Develop an original design from the photo’s subject, composition and colors, with clear hierarchy and considered space
请在模型配置中连接账户并选择可用模型: Connect an account and choose an available model in model settings
